summary: Focused iteration-2 test. Crew Edit sheet, preset seeding with Webcrafter, Builder hand-off, delete, landing hero and Chat page load all work. BLOCKER: every LLM call (OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini, both streaming and non-streaming) fails because the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is rejected with 'litellm.AuthenticationError: OpenAIException - Invalid API key', so the Webcrafter chat could not be checked. Pytest: 21/27 passed. All 6 failures are LLM tests that fail for this same reason.

critical.issue: Every model provider fails with 'Invalid API key' (litellm AuthenticationError; 24 occurrences in backend.err.log). EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set in backend/.env (sk-emerg..., 30 chars) but the proxy rejects it. The key may be invalid, expired, or out of budget. The non-stream /chat returns 502 and the stream returns an SSE error event. The Webcrafter 'coffee shop landing page' prompt could not be checked.

minor.issue: The user message is saved before the LLM call and is not rolled back on error. Chat.jsx removes it from the screen, but after a reload it appears again with no reply. Seen on Webcrafter: 'Build me a simple modern landing page for a coffee shop' with no answer.

Duplicates are detected by name only, and the dashboard calls this on every load. If a user renames a preset in the new Edit sheet (e.g. Webcrafter -> 'Web Pro'), a fresh 'Webcrafter' is created on the next dashboard load. If a user deletes a preset, it comes back on every dashboard load. Fix: store a preset_key field on seeded agents plus a per-user record of seeded or dismissed presets, and seed only once.

The update filter omits user_id (TOCTOU risk), and AgentCreate defaults silently reset any omitted fields. Clients that send partial updates will wipe data. Consider an AgentUpdate model with optional fields and exclude_unset.

integration_issues.issue: No reply is possible because of the backend LLM key error. The UI shows a toast and puts the text back in the input, which is correct handling.

issues: Hero artwork shows on the right and the headline is fully legible. No issues. The dim decorative labels (LAW, FINANCE, CREATIVE) are very low contrast, which is probably intentional.

verified_working: Each agent card has an Edit button (edit-agent-{id}) that opens crew-edit-sheet with all 7 text fields and the model filled in correctly
Changing tone, goal, description and model (to GPT 5.4 Mini) and saving: the sheet closes, the card updates, GET shows the new values, and skills, persona, background and role are kept
Reopening the sheet after a reload shows the new values
crew-edit-advanced goes to /builder with the agent loaded (fields, skill toggles, and gpt-5.4-mini shown in the preview header)
Webcrafter is present exactly once. seed-presets is idempotent (13 skipped, 0 created). Its config: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6, persona tech
Delete with confirm dialog removes the card, and GET returns 404
Chat page loads the agent name, messages, input and send button. The only console errors are 401s from /auth/me on the logged-out landing page, which is expected
Landing page: hero art is visible, the headline is legible, and google-login-button is present
action_items: CRITICAL: Fix the LLM key. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is rejected as 'Invalid API key' for all providers. Check the key's validity or budget, or ask the user to top up, then retest the Webcrafter chat.
Make preset seeding robust to renaming and deleting (preset_key plus a seed-once flag) so the Edit sheet and delete don't bring presets back
Roll back or mark the saved user message when the stream fails, so orphan prompts don't appear after a reload
Optional: add user_id to the update_one filter in update_agent
critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed_presets matches on name. This interacts badly with the new rename-capable Edit sheet and the auto-seed on dashboard load.
server.py chat_stream inserts the user message before the stream, and nothing removes it on error.
CrewEditSheet sends the full agent doc, including id, user_id and created_at. Pydantic ignores the extras, so this is fine, but the full-replace PUT is fragile.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (test_delete_agent_removes_messages now registers its id for cleanup)

success_rate.backend: 78% (21/27); all failures caused by the invalid LLM key

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Crew and TEST_EditUI and deleted both by id. A leftover TEST_Del Msgs (agent_bbfce92171d2, created by this run when the LLM test failed) was deleted by id. Side effect: one orphan user message ('Build me a simple modern landing page for a coffee shop') is now in the test user's Webcrafter history, because the failed stream does not roll back.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q. Do not pass -p no:xdist; pytest.ini uses xdist. Once the LLM key works, rerun TestWebcrafterChat.test_stream and the backend_test.py LLM tests. Test user has 16 agents: 13 presets plus DocBot and Atlas.
rca of the issue: The LLM failure is not an app code bug. The emergentintegrations LlmChat call receives EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, and the upstream proxy returns 401 'Invalid API key' for every provider. So the cause is the key's validity or balance in this environment.
